sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Where you find the departed, you'll find the Memorial Mob.
Whether it be along a recent battlefield, an abandoned dungeon...
The Memorial Mob will make an appearance.
If you seek them out, they'll surely present their wares.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: - Ashina Castle Gate Fortress: found in the alley to the right of the entrance of the building with the Tengu of Ashina inside. Defeating Gyoubu Oniwa and later the Demon of Hatred is necessary to reach him.

sections.heading: Fountainhead Palace (Fountainhead Palace)
sections.text: Upon defeating the Corrupted Monk, the Dragon's Tally Board she drops will unlock new items at every merchant.

sections.heading: Ashina Outskirts ( Outskirts Wall - Stairway )
sections.text: Complete Anayama's questline (see his page for in depth info) to acquire the Promissory Note, which will discount by 10% the cost of every item sold by merchants.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text:
First encounter with a Memorial Mob | Memorial Mob: Care to purchase an offering?
Wolf: An offering?
Memorial Mob: Indeed. I sell items to be offered to the dead, so they might rest in peace. From the looks of you, I'd wager you have a lot of blood on your hands. ...go ahead, buy an offering.
First encounter | Memorial Mob: Care to purchase an offering?
Wolf: Another one...
Memorial Mob: Where you find the departed, you'll find the Memorial Mob... A battlefield is our paradise. ...go ahead, buy an offering.
Leaving | Memorial Mob: Where you find the departed, you'll find the Memorial Mob... Wherever your travels take you, make sure you bring some offerings.
Greeting (Generic) | Memorial Mob: Care to purchase an offering?
Leaving (Generic) | Memorial Mob: May the departed rest in peace...
First encounter when infected with Dragonrot | Memorial Mob: (Wheezing)
Wolf: What's wrong with you?
Memorial Mob: Must've caught something... on the battlefield... (Wheeze... Wheeze...) Chest... So tight... I must... make an offering...
Memorial Mob: (Wheezing)
Wolf: You've caught it, too..
Memorial Mob: Must've caught something... on the battlefield... (Wheeze... Wheeze...) Chest... So tight... I must... make an offering...
"Take coughed up blood sample" | Wolf: I'm taking a blood sample. ... Now to bring this to Lady Emma.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Interacting with him or any other member of the Memorial Mob is necessary to unlock the "Memorial Mob" trophy.
- Purchasing the Gourd Seed from the Battlefield Memorial Mob is a necessary step to unlock the "Ultimate Healing Gourd" trophy.
- Purchasing Robert's Firecrackers is a necessary step to unlock the "All Prosthetic Tools" and "Master of the Prosthetic" trophies.
